senses: of such an age, so old
lex:
τηλικοῦτος, -αύτη, -οῦτο
(altern. of τηλικόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε, strength­ened form of τηλίκος), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:3, 3Ma.3:9, 4Ma.16:4 * ;]
__1. of persons,
__(a) of such an age, so old;
__(b) so young.
__2. Of things, so great: 2Co.1:10, Heb.2:3, Jas.3:4, Rev.16:18.†

strongs.def: such as this, i.e. (in (figurative) magnitude) so vast
strongs.from: from a compound of G3588 (ὁ) with G2245 (ἡλίκος) and G3778 (οὗτος)
